description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to WebRTC peer connection management, including a builder for peer connections and a connection controller that handles signaling, connection state changes, and media/data channels within a WebRTC streaming context.

classes.name: PeerConnectionBuilder
classes.description: Abstract class for building WebRTC peer connections, with a virtual method to construct a peer connection with specified observer and ICE servers.

classes.name: ConnectionController
classes.description: Manages WebRTC peer connection lifecycle, signaling, and media/data channels, implementing the PeerConnectionObserver interface and providing methods for signaling message handling and connection management.

classes.name: ConnectionController::Observer
classes.description: Interface for receiving callbacks about connection state changes, media tracks, and data channels.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Constructs a peer connection with the specified observer and ICE servers.

methods.name: RequestOffer
methods.description: Initiates the process of creating and sending an offer to establish a WebRTC connection.

methods.name: HandleSignalingMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming signaling messages from the signaling server.

methods.name: peer_connection
methods.description: Returns the current peer connection object.

methods.name: OnAddStream
methods.description: Callback when a media stream is added.

methods.name: OnRemoveStream
methods.description: Callback when a media stream is removed.

methods.name: OnDataChannel
methods.description: Callback when a data channel is added.

methods.name: OnStandardizedIceConnectionChange
methods.description: Callback for ICE connection state changes.

methods.name: OnConnectionChange
methods.description: Callback for overall peer connection state changes.

methods.name: OnIceGatheringChange
methods.description: Callback for ICE gathering state changes.

methods.name: OnIceCandidate
methods.description: Callback when a new ICE candidate is found.

methods.name: OnIceCandidateError
methods.description: Callback when an ICE candidate error occurs.

methods.name: OnIceCandidatesRemoved
methods.description: Callback when ICE candidates are removed.

methods.name: OnTrack
methods.description: Callback when a media track is received.

methods.name: OnRemoveTrack
methods.description: Callback when a media track is removed.
